The '''M102 Fire Arc Artillery Piece''' was a heavy [[projectile cannon]] produced by [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]]. Originally designed for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], disinterest in the system led it to be sold on the open market, including to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

==Description==
An attempt to recreate a market for lob-shell artillery, the M102 was a modern re-envisioning of the old, slow, towed artillery pieces of the past. Essentially a weapons platform, the M102 consisted of a slow moving heavily armored [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] chassis, a large bore artillery cannon, and a [[Tana Ire/Legends|Tana Ire]] [[GroundSweeper-3]] sensor dome (for accuracy at short ranges), the M102 was capable of firing a projectile over great distances - including against targets far out of its line of sight - up to a distance of 20 kilometers. Operated by a crew of 4, the M102 had a twenty shell capacity, with each shell consisting of a fragmenting shell capable of producing a twenty meter blast. While powerful, the fragmenting nature of these shells meant they weren't very durable; because of this, [[Point-defense laser cannon/Legends|precision laser fire]] - with great difficulty - is capable of shooting down shells in transit to their target.<ref name="Rules">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>
